nodes.label: Push-only state architecture
nodes.rationale: State is push-only — the HA integration never polls. Changes arrive in <100ms, replacing the old ADB polling approach (5s intervals). Eliminates latency and load from constant polling.

nodes.label: Curated app state detection rule database
nodes.rationale: Designed to be compatible with python-androidtv rule schema for future upstream contribution. Each app has a list of ordered rules; first match wins, allowing app-specific state detection without user configuration.

nodes.label: APK (Android App)
nodes.rationale: Sideloaded Android app in Kotlin with kotlinx.serialization and HiveMQ MQTT 5. Watches media/app/screen/volume, publishes state, subscribes to command topics. Push-only — no polling.

nodes.label: HA Integration (custom_components/fire2mqtt)
nodes.rationale: HACS custom component in Python. Subscribes to state topics, exposes entities, publishes commands. Push-only.

nodes.label: MQTT Wire Contract
nodes.rationale: The load-bearing invariant. Defined in three places that must stay in sync: Payloads.kt, schema.py, and docs/mqtt-schema.md. Changing a payload field means changing it in all three places.

nodes.label: Payloads.kt
nodes.source_location: Repo layout / The MQTT wire contract

nodes.label: coordinator.py
nodes.rationale: Push-only DataUpdateCoordinator with update_interval=None. Subscribes, parses, sends commands. Owns parsing/state/commands. State changes arrive via MQTT callbacks and call async_set_updated_data.

nodes.label: mqtt_bus.py (MqttBus)
nodes.rationale: MQTT transport layer — owns all MQTT I/O including topic building, subscribe, publish, teardown.

nodes.label: schema.py
nodes.source_location: Repo layout / The MQTT wire contract
nodes.rationale: Payload validation models. from_raw() coerces and normalizes; returns a normalized dict so entities stay dict-based. Bad-payload policy: coerce + warn + keep last good.

nodes.label: state_detection.py
nodes.rationale: Pure evaluate() function — no HA imports. Maps playback payload to HA state string. Format-compatible port of python-androidtv rule logic, slated for upstreaming.

nodes.label: data/rules.py
nodes.rationale: Contains CURATED_RULES in format-compatible with python-androidtv rule logic.

nodes.label: docs/mqtt-schema.md
nodes.source_location: Repo layout / The MQTT wire contract

nodes.label: manifest.json
nodes.rationale: requirements is [] — HA bundles what's needed (mqtt, voluptuous). No new runtime deps should be added.

nodes.label: Push-Only Pattern
nodes.rationale: Both APK and HA integration are push-only. Coordinator has update_interval=None. State changes arrive via MQTT callbacks. Never add polling.

nodes.label: Bad-Payload Policy
nodes.rationale: Coerce + warn + keep last good. _parse_json returns None on malformed JSON; from_raw coerces wrong-typed fields and logs rather than raising. Never blank out entities on one bad message.
